comparisons.name: finder-copy-light
comparisons.description: The bar of Finder’s Copy window at 3%, on the window background, Aqua. At 1x about 6.5% of the pixels differ, which is one row of the bar: in the capture the bar lies on a half point (4.5 pt below the crop’s top), so the 1x reference, an average of 2x2 blocks, spreads each of its hairlines over two rows, while a browser at 1x must draw the bar on whole pixels. The bar is not off at 1x; the 2x comparison gates its drawing.

comparisons.name: finder-copy-dark
comparisons.description: The bar of Finder's Copy window at 8%, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: time-machine-light
comparisons.description: The backup bar of the Time Machine pane at 64%, on a box, Aqua. The dark capture shows no backup in progress. At 1x about 10.5% of the pixels differ for the reason given for finder-copy-light: the bar lies on a half point in the capture; here the fill makes two rows differ over 64% of the width.

comparisons.name: track-end-light
comparisons.description: The trailing, empty end of the bar of Finder's Copy window alone, Aqua: a 15 pt square in which the rounded end of the track is a large share, so that a change of its radius shows in the score. The 1x score is high for the reason given for finder-copy-light.

comparisons.name: track-end-dark
comparisons.description: The trailing, empty end of the bar of Finder's Copy window alone, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: fill-start-light
comparisons.description: The leading, filled end of the backup bar of the Time Machine pane alone, Aqua: a 15 pt square in which the rounded end of the fill is a large share.

comparisons.name: fill-start-dark
comparisons.description: The leading, filled end of the bar of Finder's Copy window alone, Dark Aqua: a 15 pt square in which the rounded end of the fill is a large share. The dark Time Machine capture shows no bar, so the dark fill is taken from this window.
